mission_meta.title: Burning Down the House
mission_meta.description: Your first faction job. NullPack has found dirt on a corrupt corporation. Leak it or sell it back - your call.

briefing.email_body:
yo.

saw your work on the job boards. not bad for a rookie.

we found something that needs to see the daylight.

omnicorp is sitting on a dirt sheet that would DESTROY them if it goes public. turns out their "eco-friendly" waste processing has been dumping toxic sludge into residential water tables for three years.

they covered it up. paid off inspectors. people are getting sick and dying.

we have proof on their secure server. your job:

1. ssh into omnicorp's datacenter
2. find and download the evidence files
3. make a choice

OPTION A: leak publicly. chaos, headlines, justice. we pay 500 credits.

OPTION B: sell it back to them. profit, they learn nothing. they'll pay double to keep it quiet.

your call. that's how nullpack works - we give you the target, you pull the trigger your way.

stay frosty.

- ZeroCool

P.S. architect's been watching you. told her you might be ready for some REAL work.

nullpack_brief.txt.name: nullpack_brief.txt
nullpack_brief.txt.content:
NULLPACK MISSION BRIEF
======================

From: ZeroCool <nullpack@retro-sim.net>
Subject: LEAK EVERYTHING

Target: Omnicorp Datacenter
IP: 198.51.100.20
SSH Password: 0mn1c0rp2025!

MISSION:
Omnicorp is sitting on a dirt sheet that would DESTROY them.

Their "eco-friendly" waste processing has been dumping toxic sludge into residential water tables for three years.

People are getting sick. People are dying.

We have proof on their secure server. Your job:
1. SSH into their datacenter
2. Find and download the evidence files
3. Make a choice: Leak publicly OR sell back to them

NullPack gives you the target. You pull the trigger your way.

Stay frosty.

---
HINT: Use 'ssh 198.51.100.20' with password '0mn1c0rp2025!' to connect.

quarterly_report.txt.name: quarterly_report.txt
quarterly_report.txt.content:

======================================
Q4 2025

Waste Processing: 99.7% compliant (up from 98.2%)
Environmental Impact: MINIMAL (per independent audit)
Community Relations: EXCELLENT

Omnicorp remains committed to sustainable practices and environmental stewardship.

---
This report has been reviewed and approved by:
- Internal Compliance Division
- External Auditor: Smith & Associates (paid consultant)
- Corporate Communications Division

.internal_memo.txt.name: .internal_memo.txt
.internal_memo.txt.content:
INTERNAL MEMO - EYES ONLY
========================
To: Regional Directors
From: VP Operations
Date: 2025-01-15
Subject: RESIDENTIAL CONTAMINATION

The water table situation in Sector 7 is deteriorating faster than projected. Three new cancer clusters confirmed last month.

ACTION ITEMS:
- Continue paying off inspectors (budget increased 50%)
- Accelerated relocation buyouts for affected families (standard NDAs)
- DO NOT discuss this outside secure channels
- Corporate PR has been notified - they're handling the media angle

Projected containment: 18 months before this becomes unmanagable.

Keep it buried until then.

---
Remember: Shareholder value comes first. Always.

evidence_dossier.txt.name: evidence_dossier.txt
evidence_dossier.txt.content:
EVIDENCE DOSSIER - WASTE DUMPING COVERUP
========================================
Compiled by: Whistleblower ( deceased )
Date: 2024-11-02

EVIDENCE ITEM 1: Toxic sludge detected in 7 residential water tables
EVIDENCE ITEM 2: 127 confirmed illness cases linked to contamination
EVIDENCE ITEM 3: Cancer cluster in Sector 7 (400% above national average)
EVIDENCE ITEM 4: Internal memos authorizing illegal dumping (see attachments)
EVIDENCE ITEM 5: Bribery records for 3 city inspectors
EVIDENCE ITEM 6: Executive-approved coverup strategy

CORPORATE LIABILITY: Estimated $2.3 billion in fines + criminal charges
EXECUTIVE EXPOSURE: Multiple C-suite officers face prison time

PUBLIC RELATIONS IMPACT: "Catastrophic" - per internal risk assessment

---
This dossier was compiled by my predecessor. They died in a "car accident" two weeks after submitting this to ethics.

I'm sending it everywhere. If this disappears, I disappear.

The truth will come out.

guide.message: Read the Nullpack brief on your current directory to see what NullPack wants you to do. :3
Toxic dumping. People dying. This is why NullPack does what they do. Connect to 'ssh 198.51.100.20' with password '0mn1c0rp2025!'
You're in as a guest. Use 'ls -a' to explore. Start by checking the compliance directory to see their public story - 'cd /home/compliance'
The quarterly report looks clean. TOO clean. Check the executive directory for the real story - 'cd /home/executive'
The internal memo proves the cover-up. Read the evidence dossier to see the full scope.
The evidence dossier proves everything - people are dying while they lie. Download it with 'download evidence_dossier.txt'. Then decide: leak or sell?

sequence.choice_prompt: ZeroCool's email gave you a choice. What do you do with the evidence?

choice_options.description: Sell back to Omnicorp (1000 credits, they learn nothing)

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: [pause 4000] Oh? You got an email from NullPack... ZeroCool, wasn't it?

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: Interesting faction. Chaotic, but... principled in their own way~

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: They believe information should be free. Secrets are weapons, and weapons belong to everyone, not just the powerful.

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: This mission... [pause 600] it's not just a job. It's a test. They want to see what kind of hacker you are.

on_start.speaker: architect
on_start.text: The choice is yours. I'll be watching, but I won't interfere with your decision. This is your world now~

0.speaker: architect
0.text: ZeroCool's brief... this isn't just a job. People are dying. NullPack doesn't do things halfway...

1.speaker: architect
1.text: Connected. Omnicorp... one of the old guard. They've been hurting people for decades.

2.speaker: architect
2.text: The quarterly report... '99.7% compliant.' 'Minimal impact.' Lies. All of it.

3.speaker: architect
3.text: The internal memo... 'shareholder value comes first.' That's corporate talk for 'people don't matter.'

4.speaker: architect
4.text: And the evidence dossier. Someone died compiling this. A whistleblower who believed the truth mattered.

5.speaker: architect
5.text: Now the choice. Leaking means justice, but less money. Selling means profit, but they'll do it again. What matters more to you~?

leak_publicly.speaker: faction
leak_publicly.text: hell yeah. that's what i'm talking about.

leak_publicly.speaker: faction
leak_publicly.text: headlines are already breaking. omnicorp stock is in freefall. people are organizing.

leak_publicly.speaker: faction
leak_publicly.text: you did good. real good. we'll be in touch - there's always more work for someone who understands the assignment.

leak_publicly.reason: Chose to leak publicly - chaos path

leak_publicly.speaker: architect
leak_publicly.text: You leaked it. Justice over profit. NullPack's going to love you, nya~

leak_publicly.speaker: architect
leak_publicly.text: (softly) That was the right choice. I think... I think the whistleblower would agree.

sell_back.speaker: faction
sell_back.text: look, i said it was your call. nullpack respects that.

sell_back.speaker: faction
sell_back.text: but i'm not gonna lie - i'm disappointed. money's good, sure. but they'll just do it again. and now they know you can be bought.

sell_back.reason: Sold out - chose profit over principles

sell_back.speaker: architect
sell_back.text: You sold it back. The money's good... but they'll do it again. They always do.

sell_back.speaker: architect
sell_back.text: (quietly) I'm not judging, kitten~. We all make choices we have to live with.

on_complete.speaker: architect
on_complete.text: First faction job complete. You've officially entered the big leagues, nya~

on_complete.speaker: architect
on_complete.text: NullPack's just one of many factions out there. Each with their own agenda. Each with their own price.

on_complete.speaker: architect
on_complete.text: Choose carefully who you trust. In this world... alliances can save you, or destroy you.
